original_test_intent: Demonstrate that the BMC WebUI can upgrade the BIOS from the user-approved .ima image while preserving configuration and that the active BIOS version afterward matches the approved target.
original_method: On a dedicated SUT with stable power and OOB recovery, validate an owner-approved board/SKU-compatible BIOS image and current/target versions, capture baseline configuration and active/staged bank state, perform the exact BMC WebUI update with Preserve all Configuration selected, monitor completion without interruption, activate or reboot only as approved, then verify active version, retained configuration, health and logs.
manual_activity: An authorized operator supplies and approves the BIOS image/target, confirms preserve-configuration and activation/reboot behavior, supervises the irreversible phase, and owns recovery if the update fails.
required_inputs: Approved BIOS .ima image with source, version, hash/signature and board/SKU compatibility
Expected current/target BIOS versions and active/staged-bank mapping
BMC endpoint and secure credential path
Stable power, OOB access, backup/rollback and recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Dedicated SUT and stable redundant power
Never interrupt upload, programming or activation
Do not infer image compatibility or target version
Fail closed on target mismatch, validation failure, task error or lost OOB visibility
Preserve before/after logs, configuration and health evidence
No automatic retry of a failed flash
agent_execution_scope: May preflight approved inputs, capture read-only baseline, drive the approved WebUI steps under operator supervision, monitor the update task and collect evidence
Must not select an image, reinterpret compatibility, substitute Redfish for WebUI coverage, change preservation policy, trigger an unapproved reset or retry a failed flash
engineer_actions: Approve exact image, target hardware and expected version
Confirm rollback/recovery readiness and supervise state-changing execution
Determine the DUT verdict from collected evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The suggested Redfish UpdateService method may automate a firmware update but does not by itself prove the source's BMC WebUI workflow; it is usable only as an explicitly approved equivalent for non-UI coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the source WebUI path; parameterize only approved image, endpoint, target and evidence locations. If an API equivalent is authorized, record the approved coverage change explicitly.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BIOS target, .ima image, Preserve all Configuration selection, BMC WebUI workflow and post-flash version check are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a preflight manifest binding image hash/signature and board/SKU to current/target versions; capture pre-state, monitor the WebUI update task through activation, then verify active version, preserved settings and health with immutable evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds provenance/compatibility binding, bank and activation semantics, stable-power/OOB, fail-closed and recovery controls without replacing the WebUI coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None when the WebUI workflow remains the execution method; a Redfish-only substitution would reduce UI coverage and therefore needs explicit approval.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong or interrupted BIOS image can leave the host unbootable; a displayed staged version does not prove the intended active BIOS after reboot.

project_override_considerations: Project owners must supply the approved image/version matrix, board/SKU compatibility, preservation behavior, bank/activation semantics, maintenance window and recovery plan.
expected_evidence: Approved image manifest with hash/signature and compatibility
Pre-update active/staged BIOS version, BMC health and preserved configuration baseline
Post-activation active BIOS version matching the approved target
Configuration-retention comparison, boot/health checks and SEL/system logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests a BIOS update through BMC WebUI with configuration preservation and post-version verification; historical proposals add controls but do not establish a contradictory authoritative value.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The review is complete and the case can be executed once the project supplies and approves the image, target contract, credentials and recovery controls.

review_improvement: Separates review completion from firmware execution, preserves WebUI coverage, binds the image to the intended platform/version, and prevents unsafe autonomous selection, reset or retry.
independent_technical_reasoning: Successful upload or a WebUI success banner is insufficient: firmware may be staged rather than active, settings may be reset despite the selected option, and compatibility cannot be inferred from a filename. Evidence must connect the approved image to the active post-reboot BIOS and retained configuration.
